about: Differences between the model and the photos, one record per difference, found by rendering the model through a photo's solved camera and comparing it beside and over the photo. Schema, statuses and how to add, fix and close records: docs/DISCREPANCIES.md. Positions come from scripts/pixel_to_map.py (--discrepancies --write) where a contact pixel is given; scripts/discrepancies.py --check validates them.

discrepancies.description: The pool's water edge turns square round a straight-edged deck tongue that reaches into the water east of the north steps, where the pump box stands (west tip marked +). The registry water ring is a smooth curve there, so the model draws water over most of the tongue and has no square corners.
discrepancies.positionBasis: camera ray to the model ground (siteY) through IMG_2204, IMG_2205; cameras agree to 0.31 m
discrepancies.author: claude:loop-discrepancies

discrepancies.description: On the south-west side a square-cornered deck spur carries the ladder (spur tip marked +); the model's water ring and deck curve smoothly there, so the spur and its straight sides are missing and the ladder is lost in the curve.
discrepancies.positionBasis: camera ray to the model ground (siteY) through IMG_2204, IMG_2206; cameras agree to 0.59 m
discrepancies.author: claude:loop-discrepancies

discrepancies.description: The north steps are a rectangular bay inset in the pool wall with three visible white-nosed treads and a stainless step handrail at each end; the render shows only a faint translucent outline of the treads and no handrails at this distance.
discrepancies.positionBasis: camera ray to the model ground (siteY) through IMG_2204
discrepancies.author: claude:loop-discrepancies

discrepancies.description: The photo's water is a saturated mid-blue with a dark blue tiled band along the waterline and visible floor markings; the render's water is paler and greyer with only a thin dark line at the coping.
discrepancies.positionBasis: no pixel shows where it meets the ground or a known height
discrepancies.author: claude:loop-discrepancies

discrepancies.description: The deck slabs are a greyer cream with dark weathering stains and fine joints, edged by rounded pale stones at the fence; the render's deck is a brighter, uniform yellow-cream with strongly drawn joints.

discrepancies.reason: Dave, 2026-10-11: skip the glass safety fence round the pools (data/areas.json, north-pool notes). Recorded so the comparison accounts for it, not to be built.
